tasks.outcome: Make each built copy of the program carry the version of the code it was built from.

current.intent: Build or release the program so it reports which version it is.
current.system: The build script is run by someone, or by the release workflow, before the program is built.

current.intent: Have the version reflect the exact code being built.
current.system: The system asks git to describe the current commit: a tag, commit count and short commit name when tags exist, otherwise just a short commit name.

current.intent: Get the program to carry that version.
current.system: The system replaces the empty version in the generated source file with that description, so the built program carries it. The committed file keeps an empty version.
